Overview

Kailua-Kona is a city in HI with a population of 12,000. Big Island’s sunny Kona Coast with coffee farms, snorkeling, and volcanic landscapes. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 12b growing zone supports Tropical — year-round growing, tropical crops. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year.
